isl01.name: Object-Oriented Design Patterns
isl01.blurb: GoF creational, structural and behavioral patterns plus abstraction and encapsulation idioms for flexible objects.

isl02.name: Memory Management & Caching
isl02.blurb: Allocators, buffer pools, ownership and disposal, plus caching and memoization to manage memory and cut overhead.

isl03.name: Security, Auth & Cryptography
isl03.blurb: Authentication, authorization, cryptographic primitives, secure boot, and audit tactics for trustworthy systems.

isl04.name: Transactions & Durable Storage
isl04.blurb: Transactions, locking, replication and storage structures (B-trees, flash) keeping data consistent under faults.

isl05.name: Fault Tolerance & Recovery
isl05.blurb: Fault detection, recovery and containment: monitors, retries, circuit breakers, restarts, bulkheads, error kernels.

isl06.name: Concurrent Execution & Messaging
isl06.blurb: Thread pools, actors, coroutines and async models with message queues, channels and routers for concurrency.

isl07.name: Exceptions, Contracts & Testing
isl07.blurb: Exception handling, guard clauses, contracts, assertions, functional effect idioms, and test structures.

isl08.name: Data Structures & Encoding
isl08.blurb: Core data structures (arrays, hash tables, trees, heaps, sketches) plus compression and compact encodings.

isl09.name: Real-Time Scheduling & Interrupts
isl09.blurb: RTOS scheduling policies, interrupt handling, and timing tactics for real-time and embedded systems.

isl10.name: Dataflow & Reactive Streams
isl10.blurb: Streaming dataflow, reactive UI (signals, FRP, Elm/Flux), and backpressure and flow-control mechanisms.

isl11.name: Parsing, Compilers & Interpreters
isl11.blurb: Lexers, parsers, ASTs, bytecode VMs and interpreters, plus input validation and sanitization.

isl12.name: Event Notification & Pub-Sub
isl12.blurb: Observers, callbacks, pub-sub and event-driven architecture, with event aggregation and tracing.

isl13.name: Domain Modeling & Persistence
isl13.blurb: Domain-driven design and object-relational mapping: entities, value objects, repositories, aggregates.

isl14.name: Distributed Communication & Remoting
isl14.blurb: Client-server, RPC, brokers and remoting, plus networked-game state sync (prediction, lockstep).

isl15.name: Locks, Atomics & Lock-Free
isl15.blurb: Low-level synchronization: mutexes, condition variables, atomics, memory ordering, and lock-free structures.

isl16.name: Microservices & API Gateways
isl16.blurb: Service-decomposition styles (API gateways, BFF, CQRS, database-per-service) plus byte-stream wire framing.

isl17.name: Layering & Platform Abstraction
isl17.blurb: Layered architectures (Clean, Hexagonal), hardware abstraction (HAL, BSP, drivers), and game-engine loops.

isl18.name: State Machines & Numeric Precision
isl18.blurb: Finite and hierarchical state machines and control loops, plus numeric-precision arithmetic idioms.

isl19.name: Deployment, Scaling & Release
isl19.blurb: Load balancing, auto-scaling, blue-green/canary releases, feature flags, and deployment infrastructure.

isl20.name: Commands & Iteration
isl20.blurb: Command objects, undo/redo stacks, and iteration idioms: iterators, enumeration and batch methods.

isl21.name: Architecture Description & Views
isl21.blurb: Architecture viewpoints, views, frameworks and decision records for describing and documenting systems.
